title: All because of you
overview: Does a marriage need a wedding? The Yuzakis grapple with that question, as Nasa learns just how daunting the ceremony can actually be.

title: On the Subject of Happiness
overview: Old friends resurface in Nasa's life, as he introduces Tsukasa to his old teacher Yanagi Naoko.

title: Before the Fireworks Go Out
overview: Tsukasa and Nasa head to a big-name theme park, where they have a run-in with Nasa's old teacher, who might be in the middle of her own romantic encounter.

title: Spots to Kiss
overview: Nasa's knowledge is a big help to the people around him, but even he's not sure about the list Kaname finds on the internet that describes the symbolism behind different kisses.

title: The Exciting Expert of the Hot Springs
overview: Thanks to Kaname, the Yuzakis find themselves on a honeymoon trip to Kusatsu, home to some of Japan's most famous hot springs.

title: Underneath the Moon
overview: The Kusatsu trip continues, but will Nasa work up the courage to ask Tsukasa to join him in the hot springs?

title: An Expanding World
overview: Scorching summer heat motivates the Yuzakis to purchase a new air conditioner, which ends up resulting in some new encounters.

title: When You Actually Like It
overview: Nasa is forced to consider how verbally intimate he is with Tsukasa, before Kaname encourages the two of them to get physically intimate in the bathhouse after-hours.

title: A Summer Day
overview: After Tsukasa grapples with her technological anxieties, the Yuzakis are greeted by two different visitors.

title: Thank You
overview: The Yuzakis are joined by friends and family for their camping trip, but can Nasa overcome his inexperience in dealing with the outdoors?

title: On a Moonlit Night
overview: As the sun sets on the group camping trip, Tokiko and Kaname have a special surprise in store for the Yuzakis.

title: In All the Times to Come, and Beyond
overview: Nasa and Tsukasa are back home just in time to find out that they'll be moving into a new apartment soon, and Tokiko has something important to tell Nasa.
